_comment: Bigger changes that need the architect's approval. Off by default; listed in the design sheet when on.

widerBedroomWindows.label: Wider bedroom windows (west side)
widerBedroomWindows.detail: Master and kids bedroom windows widened from 5′ (1.52 m) to 7′ (2.13 m), sill lowered to 0.6 m. More light and view; needs a longer lintel and a structural check of the wall below.
widerBedroomWindows.why: Many of your references use large windows inside box frames; it reads more premium.

kitchenBalconySlider.label: Sliding glass door to the kitchen balcony
kitchenBalconySlider.detail: Kitchen → balcony door widened from 0.91 m to 1.5 m as a glazed sliding door; kitchen window sill lowered from 1.05 m to 0.9 m.
kitchenBalconySlider.why: Opens the kitchen to the road-side balcony and brings in winter sun from the south.

masterRoadWindow.label: New window on the road-side wall (master bedroom)
masterRoadWindow.detail: A 1.2 m wide window in the blank south wall of the master bedroom (sill 0.9 m, head 2.1 m), on every floor. Cross-ventilation with the west window; the name sign moves up.
masterRoadWindow.why: South light is the easiest to shade, and the blank wall becomes a lively front.

tallerStairWindows.label: Taller staircase windows
tallerStairWindows.detail: Both staircase windows on each floor made 1.8 m tall instead of 1.2 m.
tallerStairWindows.why: Brighter stair hall and a stronger rhythm on the stair tower (images 1, 25, 28).
